verdict.rationale: Rainforest documents in-person acceptance via 'Process payments with a device' and a Tap-to-Phone SDK, integrated into the same platform, merchant, and deposit/reporting infrastructure (webhooks, billing profiles, deposits) used for online payins, indicating unified settlement and reporting across channels. Missing for 10: explicit documentation showing a combined online+offline transaction ledger/reporting view or third-party terminal hardware support beyond tap-to-phone, and independent confirmation of in-person settlement flows.
